nodes.label: B-071: B-070 Options and Desk Editor Ontology Require Correction
nodes.description: Handoff status: Open, Acknowledged. Lane B's spec-defect finding that neither of B-070's two S2 authorization options is approvable after the Judge's T5/T6 clarifications. Records a terminology map (ROLE-DESK-EDITOR vs NODE-EDITORIAL-DESK-REVIEW), a normalized target model, findings B071-R1 through R22 across two independent-review rounds plus a Chief Editor clarification, and a proposed corrective decision (draft D-182, not yet in the register). This node represents lifecycle status only -- it does not assert the disputed ontology as decided, which remains the Judge's call.
nodes.rationale: B071-R15: round-2 independent review could not use graphify to locate the draft it was reviewing because neither B-071 nor its plan had a curated node, keeping graph-coverage red by design. A lifecycle-status node resolves that without pre-empting the Judge's content decision.
